_: Levels the community made with the level maker (maker.html; software/docs/LEVEL_MAKER.md). One entry per stage module in this folder: id is the file's name without .js, name what the level is called, author who made it, kind what it is for - a room for the stages page, 'tea' (untimed) or 'chase' (timed), or a level for one of the glitch range's games on glitch.html, 'watch' | 'glass' | 'lock' | 'dog' | 'wall'. Add a level = the module + a line here, kept sorted by id; software/tools/verify-maker.mjs proves every listed level is well formed and solvable (a room) or what it claims to be (a range level, through src/rangecheck.js as the shipped ranges are) before a deploy, and that nothing in this folder goes unlisted. The stages page (index.html) plays every room listed here, in order, behind its Rooms mode; the range page (glitch.html) adds every range level as the last tab of its range.
